hypothesis: H-C08-2: if the minimal recurrence of G has a characteristic root beta != alpha (dominant) with |beta| >= 1, then o_s is non-associative for every shift s. H-C08-3: if it is Pisot (all other roots inside the unit circle), o_s is associative for all sufficiently large s.
methodology: Classify each base sequence (geometric / Pisot / non-Pisot) by the roots of its minimal polynomial; test associativity per shift; report the set of associative shifts.
